faqs.a: Gather a group of interested neighbors and complete the Neighbors Connected Enrollment Form. Locate your neighborhood using the Neighborhood Search Tool. Attend a quarterly Neighborhood Leader Network meeting. Plan a project or activity with your group. Apply for a Neighborhood Grant each spring or rent the Block Party Trailer for your next summer or fall gathering!
